apart to check, not just that they were well-formed, but that they corresponded to formulae for valid proofs. This works for establishing whether a sequence of formulas is or is not a proof, but it is quite different from checking whether a proof exists for an arbitrary formula.

That is, assuming that there could be a function to check whether or not a formula was a theorem rendered the system inconsistent. And omitting the assumption rendered it incomplete.

zh: 接受排中律（LEM）的逻辑学家一致认为，宁取相容性而非完备性，是最稳妥的做法。对于不完备的系统，会有一些公式，我们无法保证判定它们是否为定理。如果简单地将它们加入系统作为公理，就可能利用它们证明矛盾。然而，对于相容的系统，一旦证明一个公式是定理，就知道无法证明它的否定。
en: Logicians who accept the LEM are agreed that preferring consistency to completeness is the safest course. For an incomplete system, there will be arbitrary formula whose status as theorems we cannot guarantee to determine. If they are simply added to the system as axioms, then it might be possible to use them to prove contradictions. However, for a consistent system, once we prove that a formula is a theorem, we know that we cannot prove its contrary.

zh: 图灵与终止性
五年后，艾伦·图灵（1912—1954）证明，希尔伯特纲领的第三项要求无法得到满足。
也就是说，不可能构造一种会终止的机械程序，来判定一个公式是否为定理。
en: Five years later, Alan Turing (1912–54) showed that the third requirement of Hilbert’s programme could not be satisfied.
That is, it is not possible to construct a terminating mechanical procedure for deciding whether or not a formula is a theorem.

zh: 图灵的进路与上文讨论的数理逻辑学家很不一样。他没有使用诸如把谓词演算应用于集合论或数论而得到的形式系统，而是考察人们怎样用手工解决问题。他设想，一个人用铅笔和方格纸，在格子里逐个字母写下问题，然后来回处理，修改已有格子的内容，并写入新的格子。
en: Turing’s approach was very different from that of the mathematical logicians we have considered above. Rather than using a formal system derived, say, from predicate calculus applied to set or number theory, Turing considered how people solve problems by hand. He speculated about someone using a pencil and squared paper, writing down a problem in the squares, letter by letter, and then working backwards and forwards, changing squares and writing in new ones.

zh: 图灵把这一构想推广为现在所谓的图灵机（TM）。图灵机有一条由单元格组成的有限线性纸带，每个格子可以存放一个符号。有一个读写头，能够检查和修改格子；它位于“当前”格子的上方。例如，图9.1描绘了一台示意性的图灵机，纸带上逐个符号写着肯定前件式。
en: Turing generalized this conception to what is now known as a

. A TM has a finite linear tape of cells. Each cell may hold a symbol. There is a reading head that can inspect and change cells. The head is positioned over the ‘current’ cell. For example, Figure 9.1 shows a stylized TM with Modus Ponems on the tape, symbol by symbol.

zh: 纸带可以向左或向右移动，每次移动一格。到达纸带任一端时，便添加新的空格。因此，纸带可以增长到任意长度，但在任何阶段，它总是有界的，即长度始终有限。
en: The tape may be moved to the left or the right, one cell at a time. New empty cells are added when either end of the tape is reached. Thus, the tape may grow to be arbitrarily long, but, at any stage, it is always bounded, that is, it is always of finite length.

zh: 图灵机通过反复检查和修改纸带来执行操作，每次处理一个格子。机器的行为倾向，即当前符号如何结合它此前的操作来决定下一步做什么，称为当前状态。
en: A TM executes by repeatedly inspecting and modifying the tape, one cell at a time. The propensity of the machine, that is, how the current symbol determines what it will do next, in the light of what it has done previously, is called the current

, i.e., left or right, or halt.

和
与当前状态及读写头下的符号相匹配，然后执行它。若不存在这样的指令，计算就失败。利用查找、修改和复制符号序列这些基本操作，可以构造复杂的图灵机。
en: The machine is set up with the instructions in a control unit. This repeatedly looks for an instruction whose

match the current state and symbol under the head, which is then carried out. If there is no such instruction, the computation fails. Elaborate TMs may be constructed from the basic operations of searching for, changing and copying sequences of symbols.

zh: 图灵的关键洞见是，图灵机的纸带可以存放任何符号序列，包括一组图灵机指令的符号序列。事实上，可以构造一台通用图灵机（UTM），配以适当的数据，逐个符号执行存放在其纸带上的任意图灵机。
en: Turing’s key insight was that a TM tape could hold any symbol sequence, including that for a set of TM instructions. Indeed, it is possible to construct a
TM (UTM) that will execute an arbitrary TM, held on its tape, symbol by symbol, with appropriate data.

zh: 面对任意图灵机究竟是否会终止这一问题，图灵构造了如下悖论。假设纸带上存放一台“待测试”图灵机的符号及其数据。再假设我们能够构造一台“停机判定”图灵机，它检查纸带：如果待测试机在其数据上停机，就以一个状态停下；如果待测试机在其数据上不停机，就以另一个状态停下。
en: Asking whether or not an arbitrary TM will ever terminate, Turing constructed a paradox as follows: Suppose we have the symbols for a ‘test’ TM and its data on a tape. Let’s assume that we can build a ‘halting’ TM that will inspect the tape and stop in one state if the ‘test’ TM halts on its data and in another state if the ‘test’ TM doesn’t halt on its data.

zh: 写出一台不停机的图灵机很容易。它从一个空格开始，写入0，然后向右移动一格。若右边没有格子，就增加一个。实际上，这台图灵机会永远“循环”，使纸带向无限延伸，却永远达不到无限。
en: It is easy to write a TM that doesn’t halt. It starts on a blank cell, writes a 0 and moves one cell to the right. If there isn’t a cell to the right, a new one is added. In effect, this TM will ‘loop’ forever, extending the tape to infinity, without ever reaching it.

zh: 我们可以修改这台停机判定机：如果待测试机在其数据上不停机，它就以一个状态停下；如果待测试机在其数据上停机，它就执行那条循环指令。
en: We can modify the ‘halting’ TM to halt in one state if the ‘test’ TM doesn’t halt on its data and to execute the loop instruction if the ‘test’ TM does halt on its data.

zh: 假设把修改后的停机判定机应用于它自身及某条纸带。如果它处理自身时不停机，那么它就会停机；如果它处理自身时停机，那么它就进入循环，不再停机。图灵得出结论：不可能构造一台图灵机来判断任意图灵机是否停机；也就是说，图灵机的停机问题不可判定。
en: Suppose we apply the modified ‘halting’ TM to itself and some tape. If it doesn’t halt on itself, then it halts, and if it does halt on itself, then it goes into the loop, and doesn’t halt. Turing concluded that it wasn’t possible to construct a TM to tell if an arbitrary TM halts; that is, the TM
is

zh: 这一结果来自图灵在考察生成实数的图灵机时，使用康托尔对角线法作出的更详尽论证。虽然上文批评了对角线法这一整个观念，认为它涉及已完成的无限，但这并不使停机问题核心的悖论失效。
en: This result falls out of Turing’s more elaborate argument using Cantor diagonalization in considering TMs that generate real numbers. While above we critiqued the whole notion of diagonalization as involving completed infinities, this does not invalidate the paradox at the heart of the halting problem..

zh: 丘奇—图灵论题
在哥德尔和图灵开展工作的同时，人们还探索了其他几种元数学形式体系。斯蒂芬·克莱尼（1909—1994）沿着传统路线发展出递归函数论，将皮亚诺归纳法反转为一种定义数或集合上的函数的形式。
en: Several other formalisms for meta-mathematics were explored in the same period that Gödel and Turing were working. Along traditional lines, Stephen Kleene (1909–94) developed recursive function theory, which inverted Peano’s induction into a form for defining functions over number or sets.

zh: 相比之下，摩西·舍恩芬克尔（1888—1942）早在1924年就发展了组合逻辑。
哈斯克尔·柯里（1900—1982）于1929年加以完善，
由此引出了阿隆佐·丘奇（1903—1995）自1932年起关于λ演算的极有影响力的工作。
en: In contrast, Moses Schönfinkel (1888–1942) had developed combinatory logic in 1924.
This was refined by Haskell Curry (1900–82) in 1929,
and led to the highly influential work by Alonzo Church (1903–95) on λ calculus, from 1932.

zh: 对辩证唯物主义的拥护者而言，这些系统似乎尤其成问题。舍恩芬克尔和柯里的组合逻辑由算子构成；算子的性质通过它们如何消去或复制其他算子、从而与之相互作用来定义。丘奇的λ演算则是纯粹抽象的，其规则通过代入来组合抽象。二者都不涉及具体的值。
en: These systems seem particularly problematic for adherents of dialectical materialism. Schönfinkel’s and Curry’s combinatory logics are built from operators whose properties are defined by how they interact with other operators by eliminating or duplicating them. And Church’s λ calculus is one of pure abstraction, with rules for combining abstractions through substitution. Neither makes any reference to concrete values.

zh: 不过，这些系统有一个关键性质：它们都能够表示逻辑和算术，因此都能把握希尔伯特纲领核心的定理与证明概念。这就是丘奇—图灵论题的根源：所有对数进行计算的系统都在如下意义上等价，即任一系统都能翻译成其他任一系统。换言之，没有什么能在一个系统中表达，却不能在其他系统中表达。
en: Nonetheless, a key property of these systems is that they are all capable of representing logic and arithmetic, so they can all capture the notions of theorem and proof at the heart of Hilbert’s programme. This is the root of the Church-Turing thesis: that all systems for performing calculations on numbers are equivalent in the sense that any may be translated into any other. That is, there is nothing that can be expressed in one system that cannot be expressed in any other system.

zh: 递归函数论、λ演算和图灵机在提出后不久，就被证明相互等价。
后来，人们证明它们与冯·诺伊曼机，即一般化的数字计算机等价，因而与任意编程语言等价。模拟计算和量子计算
的形式化也被证明满足丘奇—图灵论题。
en: Recursive function theory, λ calculus and TMs were all demonstrated to be equivalent soon after they were developed.

Subsequently, they were shown to be equivalent to von Neuman machines, that is, generalized digital computers, and, hence, to arbitrary programming languages. Formalizations of analogue computing, and of quantum computing,
have also been shown to satisfy the Church-Turing thesis.

zh: 请注意，这是一个推测性的论题，而不是能够证明的理论。我们不知道可能有多少种不同的等价系统。不过，它是可证伪的：某个新系统仍可能被证明具有不同于当前已知系统的性质，因而无法相互翻译。也就是说，丘奇—图灵论题可以作为经验性的常规科学的一部分接受实验研究。事实上，我们将在后文论证，它对于更广泛地理解现实具有核心意义。
en: Note that this is a speculative
not a provable
. We do not know how many different equivalent systems there might be. Nonetheless, it is a falsifiable
, as it may yet be proved that some new system has different properties to those that are currently known, and so there is no mutual translation. That is, the Church-Turing
is subject to experimental investigation as part of empirical normal science. Indeed, we will argue subsequently that it is central to a wider understanding of reality.

zh: 从根本上说，所有这些系统都能够实现计算。这在图灵机中十分明确：机器处理纸带上的数据。对于组合子和λ演算，指令与数据没有明显的区分，规则作用于公式，直到公式无法再简化。
en: At heart, all these systems enable computation. This is explicit in TMs, where the machine manipulates the data on the tape. For combinators and λ calculus, where there is no obvious separation of instructions and data, rules are applied to formula until they cannot be simplified any further.

zh: 图灵机与其他形式体系的根本区别就在这里。一组图灵机指令是建造实际机器的蓝图；这种机器能像数字计算机一样，自主地处理其数据。相反，其他形式系统需要人或解释装置来执行规则。我们认为，这是支持图灵机在阐述唯物主义时具有首要地位的有力论据，后文还会讨论。
en: Herein lies the fundamental difference between TMs and other formalisms. A set of TM instructions is a blueprint for building an actual machine which, like a digital computer, will run autonomously on its data. In contrast, other formal systems require a human being, or an interpreting device, to carry out their rules. We think that this is a strong argument for the primacy of TMs in elaborating a materialism, and will return to this subsequently.

en: For the dialectical materialists, Gödel’s and Turing’s results were further demonstrations of the limitations of logic without dialectics. Writing in 1938,
the Communist mathematician Alister Watson (1908–82)
thought that all the paradoxes

children: merely express in one way or another the well-known difficulties which arise when we attempt to treat an infinite process as completed.

zh: 沃森指的是亚里士多德对潜无限与实无限的区分。我们同意沃森：假定实无限存在，会使康托尔对角线法之类的方法成问题。不过，如果沃森把图灵机的纸带认作已完成的无限，那就错了。无论如何，图灵关于停机问题不可判定的结果，可以不依靠对角线法来确立。
en: Watson is referring to Aristotle’s distinction between potential and actualized infinity. We agree with Watson that the assumption of actualized infinities makes, for example, Cantor diagonalization problematic. However, Watson would be wrong to identify TM tapes as completed infinities. In any case, Turing’s result of the undecidability of the halting problem may be established without diagonalization.

zh: 沃森对元数学的怀疑十分清楚：
en: Watson’s scepticism about meta-mathematics is clear:

en: The Second World War, unprecedented in mass cruelty and immiseration, hastened the development of modern computers.

The Harvard Mark 1, built by IBM as the Automatic Sequence Controlled Calculator (ASCC), was designed by Howard Aitken (1900–73) in 1937, and first ran in 1944. It was electro-mechanical and could store data, but lacked the capability to store programs.

Instructions were encoded on punched paper tape to control a linear sequence of operations. Looping programs were accomplished by repeating the tape, and branching by changing tapes. The Mark 1 was used by John von Neumann (1903– 57) to perform calculations for the Manhattan Project, developing the first atomic bombs.

en: The Electronic Numerical Integrator and Computer (ENIAC), among the first all electronic general-purpose computers, was completed in 1945. ENIAC was used, among other things, in the calculations for the first hydrogen bombs.

zh: 沃洛希诺夫认为，物化于言语中的语言具有首要地位。主题承载意识形态，符号具有“社会多重重音性”（第23页）。词语的评价性重音由表达性语调决定（第103页）。语调及其解释方式也反映说话者与听者的阶级取向。因此，“符号成为阶级斗争的场所”（第23页），在这里：
en: Vološinov saw language materialized in speech as primary. Themes bear ideology, and signs have ‘social
’ (p23). Words have
determined by
(p103). The intonation, and how it is interpreted, also reflect the class orientations of speakers and listeners. Thus, ‘Sign becomes an arena of class struggle’ (p23), where:

zh: 统治阶级力图赋予意识形态符号一种超阶级的、永恒的性质，消灭符号内部社会价值判断之间的斗争，或者把这种斗争压入内部，使符号只有单一重音。（第23页）
en: The ruling class strives to impart a supraclass, eternal character to the ideological sign, to extinguish or drive inward the struggle between social value judgements which occurs in it, to make the sign uniaccentual. (p23)

zh: 沃洛希诺夫赞同地引用同时代的尼古拉·马尔（1864—1934），断言“语言学是语文学的产物”。二人都批评传统语文学把话语当作脱离动态言语交往的独白来研究（第72页），但都认为可以在物质文化的背景中追溯语言的起源。
en: Vološinov approvingly cites his contemporary Nikolai Marr (1864–1934) in asserting that ‘linguistics is the child of philology’. Both criticized traditional philology for focusing on utterances as monologues separated from dynamic verbal interactions (p72), but both thought it possible to derive the origins of languages in the contexts of material cultures.

zh: 不过，与沃洛希诺夫不同，马尔认为不存在无阶级的语言。马泰卡
将沃洛希诺夫失势归因于这一分歧（第173页）。
en: However, unlike Vološinov, Marr thought that no language could be classless. Matejka
attributes Vološiinov’s fall from favour to this difference (p173).

zh: 马尔也拒斥形式逻辑，认为它以阶级为基础：
en: Marr also rejected formal logic as class based:

zh: 形式逻辑是阶级思维的产物，它连同创造它的阶级，被无产阶级的辩证唯物主义思维一扫而去；在这种思维中，思想取得了凌驾于语言之上的地位。（转引自马蒂亚斯
en: Formal logic, a product of class thinking, together with the class that created it, is swept away by the dialectical materialist thinking of the proletariat in which thought gains ascendancy over language. (cited in Mathias

zh: 直到1950年，马尔一直是苏联最受推崇的语言学家。
en: Marr was the preferred Soviet linguistic until 1950.

zh: 苏联逻辑学的复兴
1945年美国引爆三枚原子弹，从根本上改变了苏联科学工作的优先次序，削弱了意识形态，尤其是反形式主义，在政策中的支配地位。
en: The detonation of three atomic bombs by the USA in 1945 radically changed Soviet priorities in science and weakened the dominance of ideology in policy, in particular anti-formalism.

zh: 1945年8月，苏联成立两个机构来管理原子弹研发。
（第131页）苏联第一个计算机项目于1946年在基辅启动，由谢尔盖·列别杰夫（1902—1974）领导，MESM于1950年投入运行。然而，维纳的著作
出版后，一场反控制论运动展开了，理由是控制论属于资本主义创新，旨在削弱工人阶级组织，最终完全取代工人，使他们陷于赤贫。
（第128页）这表明，这些意识形态家对马克思主义经济学，以及活劳动在资本主义剩余价值生产中的核心作用，了解甚少。在马克思的体系中，利润来自人的活动，而非机器。而且，正如乌斯丁
所述，苏联军方迅速采用控制论，并“将意识形态考虑放到一边”（第312页）。
en: Two Soviet agencies were set up in August 1945 to manage Soviet atomic bomb development
(p131). The first Soviet computer project began in Kiev in 1946, directed by Sergey Lebedev (1902–74), and the MESM became operational in 1950. However, after the publication of Wiener’s book,

a campaign against cybernetics was mounted on the grounds that it was a capitalist innovation to weaken working-class organization and, ultimately, entirely supplant workers who would be left destitute

(p128). This suggests that the ideologues had little grasp of Marxist economics, and the central role of living labour in the production of surplus value under capitalism. In Marx’s scheme, profits derive from human activity, not machines. And, as Usdin
notes, the Soviet military was quick to deploy cybernetics and ‘push ideological considerations aside’ (p312).

zh: 尽管如此，计算机仍不得不被称为“数学机器”，以避开针对控制论的审查。
人们明确区分两者：用控制论模拟人类行为不可接受，而用计算机进行计算和自动化则可以。把计算机类比于人脑被视为“荒谬”。
（第142—143页）对唯物主义来说，这一立场似乎完全是一种倒退。如果人不只是机器，那么人的额外特性就必然来自非物质的属性。
en: Nonetheless, computers had to be presented as ‘mathematical machines’ to evade cybernetic scrutiny.

A clear distinction was made between the unacceptable use of cybernetics to model human behaviour and the use of computers for calculations and automation. Analogies between computers and human brains were deemed ‘absurd’
(p142–3). This stance seems entirely retrogressive for materialism. If humans are more than machines, then their additional qualities must derive from non-corporeal properties.

zh: 回到逻辑学，苏联教育中的变化来得很快。1946年苏共（布）中央委员会的一项指令，
由坎贝尔
引述，指出
en: Returning to logic, change came quickly in Soviet education. A 1946 CPSU(B) Central Committee directive,
cited by Campbell,
noted that it was:

zh: 中学不教授逻辑学和心理学，是很不恰当的。（第343页）
en: quite improper that logic and psychology are not taught in secondary schools. (p343)

zh: 并制定了开设这些课程的计划，配以资源。马蒂亚斯
因此叙述，切尔帕诺夫1918年版的《逻辑学教科书》于1946年重印，随后出版了斯特罗戈维奇的《逻辑学》、阿斯穆斯的一部新教科书，以及斯特罗戈维奇著作的又一版（第8页）。
en: and set out plans, with resources, for their introduction. Thus, Mathias
recounts how a 1918 edition of Chelapanov’s
was republished in 1946, followed by Strogovich’s
, a new textbook by Asmus, and a further edition of Strogovich (p8).

zh: 洛伦兹
指出，继李森科在遗传学上取得所谓成就之后，1948年曾有人推动苏联更广泛的科学工作系统地服从“科学具有阶级性”这一观念。然而，数学和物理学方面的计划被原子导弹项目负责人贝利亚叫停，因为“有影响力的物理学家向他解释，这可能损害这些项目”（第217—218页）。
en: Lorentz

observes that, following Lysenko’s alleged achievements in genetics, there were moves in 1948 to systematically align wider Soviet science with the notion that science had a class character. However, the plans for mathematics and physics were halted by Beria, the chief of Atomic Missile Projects, after ‘influential physicists explained to him that this may damage these projects’ (p217–8).

zh: 1952年，坎贝尔
指出，苏联逻辑教育面临着如何调和“资产阶级”逻辑与辩证逻辑的问题。他概述奥斯马科夫
1950年的一篇文章，认为其主张是：
en: In 1952, Campbell
noted the problems for Soviet logic education of squaring ‘bourgoise’ logic with dialectical logic. He summarizes a 1950 article by Osmakov
as arguing that:

zh: 与世界观不同，思维逻辑是一种无阶级的现象。（第281页）
en: Unlike a world outlook, the logic of thinking is a
phenomenon. (p281)

zh: 此外，还有一句令人强烈联想到亚里士多德的表述：
en: Further, in a formulation strongly reminiscent of Aristotle:

zh: 思维逻辑据以进行的概念，对客观现实反映得好或不好，取决于思考者的意识形态或世界观。（第282页）
en: The concepts on the basis of which the logic of thinking proceeds reflect objective reality well or badly according to the ideology or world view of the thinker. (p282)

zh: 巴扎诺夫
和基拉科斯
叙述了亚诺夫斯卡娅如何成为苏联形式逻辑复兴的核心人物。1947年，她翻译了形式主义者希尔伯特和阿克曼的《理论逻辑纲要》，1948年又翻译了塔尔斯基的《逻辑与演绎科学方法论导论》。
1947年，亚诺夫斯卡娅主张，应当把“数理逻辑的方法论形式主义”与其背后的唯心主义哲学区分开来，因为
数理逻辑

and Kilakos
recount how Yanovskya was central to the revival of Soviet formal logic. In 1947, she had translated
by the formalists Hilbert and Ackermann and, in 1948, Tarski’s

children: Introduction to logic and the methodology of deductive sciences.

en: In 1947, Yanovskya was arguing that ‘methodological formalism of mathematical logic’ should be distinguished from the idealist philosophy underlying it, because
mathematical logic

zh: 不仅可以被视为数学的逻辑，也可以被视为逻辑的数学，因为它在很大程度上是将数学方法应用于逻辑问题的结果。
en: can be considered not only as logic of mathematics but also as mathematics of logic, for it is in large part the result of the application of mathematical methods to the problems of logic.

zh: 这一论证回到布尔对逻辑的数学化，巧妙地倒转了元数学所宣称的目标。
en: This argument returns to Boole’s mathematicization of logic, neatly inverting the stated objective of meta-mathematics.

zh: 亚诺夫斯卡娅在此后的一生中始终推动形式逻辑的发展。她享有很高声望，从1959年起担任莫斯科国立大学数理逻辑教席，直至1966年去世。
en: Yanovskaya promoted formal logic throughout the rest of her life. Held in high esteem, she was the Chair of Mathematical Logic at Moscow State University from 1959 until her death in 1966.

zh: 斯大林论语言学
1950年，斯大林对马尔的批驳，预示着反形式主义立场公开逆转。正如洛伦兹
所述，斯大林密切关注精密科学的发展，虽支持李森科，却怀疑科学普遍具有阶级性：
en: In 1950, the public reversal of anti-formalism was heralded by Stalin’s repudiation of Marr. As Lorentz
observes, Stalin paid close attention to developments in exact science and, while endorsing Lysenko, expressed scepticism about science’s general class character:

zh: 哈哈哈。那数学呢？达尔文主义呢？（第217页）
en: Ha, ha, ha. And what about mathematics? And about Darwinism? (p217)

zh: 《马克思主义和语言学问题》
于1950年发表在《真理报》，随后又有四次进一步澄清的交流。在最初的文章中，斯大林彻底拒斥马尔语言学的两项核心主张，认为语言既不是基础，也不是上层建筑，并且不具有阶级标记。这些批评也适用于沃洛希诺夫。
en: was published in

in 1950, followed by four further clarificatory exchanges. In the original article, Stalin roundly rejects two key tenets of Marr’s linguistics, arguing that language is neither base nor superstructure, and is not class marked. These criticisms also apply to Voloŝinov.

zh: 在后来答复克拉舍宁尼科娃时，斯大林承认语义学对语言学的重要性，同时批评马尔过分强调语义学。从上下文看，斯大林似乎再次批评马尔按说话者的阶级，赋予词语和表达不同的意义。他认为，这种差异很少，存在于个别词语中，而不在所有说话者共有的语法中。
en: In a subsequent reply to Krasheninnikova, Stalin chided Marr for overemphasizing semantics while acknowledging its importance for linguistics. From the context, Stalin appears to again be criticizing Marr for attributing different meanings to words and expressions, depending on a speaker’s class. He suggests that such differences are very few, and lie in individual words, not in grammar, which is common to all speakers.

zh: 最重要的是，斯大林表明，以形式主义之名作为决定性批评的做法已经结束：
en: Most significantly, Stalin signalled the end of the attribution of formalism as a decisive critique:

zh: N. Y. 马尔认为，语法是空洞的“形式”，把语法体系视为语言基础的人是形式主义者。这完全是愚蠢的。
en: N. Y. Marr considered that grammar is an empty ‘formality’, and that people who regard the grammatical system as the foundation of language are formalists. This is altogether foolish.

zh: 我认为，“形式主义”是“新学说”的作者们发明的，目的是便利他们与语言学对手的斗争。
en: I think that ‘formalism’ was invented by the authors of the ‘new doctrine’ to facilitate their struggle against their opponents in linguistics.

zh: 此后，苏联逻辑学蓬勃发展，尽管辩证法与逻辑关系的争论仍在继续。
十七年后，即1967年，科普宁
仍在援引恩格斯
来捍卫黑格尔的真理。
en: Thereafter, Soviet logic flourished, though debate about the relationship between dialectics and logic continued.
Seventeen years later, in 1967, Kopnine
was still citing Engels
in defending the Hegelian verities.

zh: 不过，1959年一份访苏美国计算机科学家的报告
表明，苏联逻辑与计算领域的进展给他们留下了深刻印象。他们指出：
en: Nonetheless, a 1959 report
by US computer scientists visiting the Soviet Union showed that they were very impressed by progress in logic and computing. They note that:

zh: 莫斯科、基辅和列宁格勒大学里，直接或间接与计算机有关的逻辑学家和数学家，显然比西欧或美国任何大学的都更多、更优秀。（第17页）
en: There are obviously more and better logicians and mathematicians connected directly or indirectly with computers at Moscow, Kiev, and Leningrad Universities than at any universities in Western Europe or the United States. (p17)

zh: 他们还指出，除MIT以外，美国没有能够与莫斯科国立大学相比的“面向计算机”的逻辑教学项目（第17页），并警告说，苏联培养的
en: They further note that, outside of MIT, the USA lacked programs in ‘computer oriented’ logic comparable to that at Moscow State University (p17), and warned that the production of:

zh: 合格的、面向计算机的数学家，而不只是计算机程序员，其人数可能很快超过美国。（第17页）
en: qualified computer oriented mathematicians, not just computer programmers - may, soon surpass that of the United States. (p17)

zh: 构造主义
苏联构造逻辑学派由小安德烈·马尔可夫
构造主义根植于直觉主义，却像柯尔莫哥洛夫的进路一样，具有唯物主义取向。
en: The Soviet school of
logic was founded by Andrey Markov Jr.
Constructivism had its roots in intuitionism, but with a materialist orientation, as in Kolmogorov’s approach.

zh: 直觉主义以唯心主义为基础，因此苏联逻辑学家接受它，似乎令人意外。不过，马尔可夫的合作者纳戈尔尼认为，在“解冻”之前，集合论尽管具有柏拉图主义根源，却被视为唯物主义而非唯心主义。
此外，范杜拉基斯
指出，一旦将布劳威尔直觉主义的逻辑框架与其哲学分开，前者就被认为与辩证唯物主义相容。正如沙宁在1962年所写：
en: Given the idealism underlying intuitionism, its embrace by Soviet logicians may seem surprising. However, Markov’s collaborator Ngorny suggests that, before the ‘thaw’, set theory was seen as materialist rather than idealist, despite its Platonic roots.
Further, Vandoulakis
notes that Brouwer’s intuitionism was seen as consistent with dialectical materialism, once its logical framework was separated from his philosophy. As Ŝanin wrote in 1962:

zh: 越过直觉主义哲学的表层，人们在许多情况下能够发现：对于数学抽象形成过程和数学逻辑基础所涉及的根本问题，存在非常有价值的具体观察和深刻的具体分析。（第7页）
en: outside of the surface of intuitionistic philosophy one finds in many cases very valuable concrete observations and profound concrete analysis of the fundamental problems relating to the processes of forming mathematical abstractions and logical foundations of mathematics. (p7)

zh: 马尔可夫的学生库什纳指出其构造主义的四个核心特征。
首先，研究对象是有限的，由有限的构造过程，从有限字母表出发，依照明确的算法形成规则生成。沙宁正确地把这一点视为构造主义取得成功的关键：
en: Markov’s student Kushner identified four central characteristics of Markov’s constructivism.

First of all, the objects under investigation are finite and generated by finite constructive processes from a finite alphabet according to definite rules of algorithm formation. Ŝanin rightly saw this as key to the success of constructivism:

zh: 以精确的算术算法概念丰富数学，为许多作者沿新方向开展富有成果的研究提供了起点。（第6页）
en: The enrichment of mathematics with the precise concept of arithmetic algorithm served as a starting point for fruitful investigation in a new direction by many authors. (p6)

zh: 其次，库什纳指出，构造主义与直觉主义一样，拒斥排中律和双重否定，存在性证明必须以构造为基础。第三，它接受潜无限而不接受实无限。最后，可计算性与算法相联系；它接受经经验验证的丘奇—图灵论题，即所有可计算性模型的等价性。
en: Secondly, Kushner notes that, as with intuitionism, both the law of the excluded middle and double negation are rejected, and proofs of existence must be based on construction. Third, potential infinities are accepted, but not actualized infinities. And, finally, computability is associated with algorithms, and the Church-Turing thesis of the equivalence of all models of computability, demonstrated empirically, is accepted.

zh: 与图灵一样，马尔可夫从作为纸笔物质过程的数学出发。例如，他考虑在构成书稿的纸上画出一排竖线。在讨论这些线条随后如何经印刷复制时，他指出：
en: Like Turing, Markov started from mathematics as a material process using pen and paper. As an example, he considers drawing a row of vertical pen strokes on the paper forming his book manuscript. Discussing how this is subsequently reproduced by printing, he observes that:

zh: 这个构造对象［即原始图画］是由纸张和干墨水组成的物体，上面的图画则是这一构造对象的副本，由纸张和干的印刷油墨组成。它也是构造对象，因为制作副本可以被视为一种构造活动。
en: The constructive object [ie the original drawing] is a material body consisting of paper and dried ink, and the drawing given above is a copy of this constructive object, consisting of paper and dried typographic paint. It, too, is a constructive object, since the preparation of a copy may be considered a constructive act.

zh: 马尔可夫明确承认物质现实的限制：
en: Markov explicitly acknowledges the limits of material reality:

zh: 在执行构造过程时，我们常常碰到时间、空间和材料不足所造成的障碍。通常总能设法绕过这些障碍。然而，我们的构造能力确实有限，也没有理由假定，由这种限制引起的障碍总能消除。恰恰相反，现代物理学和宇宙学似乎表明，这些障碍原则上无法克服。
en: Carrying out constructive processes, we often come up against obstacles connected with a lack of time, space and material. One usually succeeds in somehow by-passing these obstacles. However, our constructive possibilities really are limited, and there are no grounds for supposing that the obstacles caused by their restrictedness can always be obviated. Rather to the contrary, it seems that modern physics and cosmology testify to the impossibility in principle of surmounting such obstacles.

zh: 不过，用亚里士多德式的表述来说，潜在可行性这一抽象
en: Nonetheless, in an Aristotelian formulation, the

zh: 使我们能够考虑任意长的构造过程和任意大的构造对象。它们的可行性是潜在的：如果有足够的空间、时间和材料，它们在实践中就是可行的。
en: allows us to consider arbitrarily long constructive processes and arbitrarily large constructive objects. Their feasibility is potential: they would be feasible in practice, had we available sufficient space, time and material.

zh: 马尔可夫明确把这种进路与基于集合论的经典数学相对照。后者允许实无限的抽象，
并以否定不存在来确立存在，其中“甚至可能不知道如何构造所需对象”。
en: Markov explicitly contrasts this approach with classical mathematics based on set theory, which allows abstractions of actual infinity
and for which existence is a consequence of refuting non-existence, where ‘a method for constructing the desired object may even be unknown’.

zh: 马尔可夫的记号体系以重写符号序列的规则为基础，类似乔姆斯基后来对形式文法类别的刻画。一套这样的规则称为算法；马尔可夫将其特征概括为：
en: Markov’s notation was based on rules for rewriting symbol sequences, similar to Chomsky’s subsequent characterization of classes of formal grammars. A
of such rules is called an
, which Markov characterized as:

zh: a) 规定精确，不留任意选择的余地，而且具有普遍可理解性——算法的确定性；
en: a) the precision of the prescription, leaving no place to arbitrariness, and its universal comprehensibility – the definiteness of the algorithm;

zh: b) 可以从在给定范围内变化的初始数据出发——算法的通用性；
en: b) the possibility of starting out with initial data, which may vary within given limits – the generality of the algorithm;

zh: c) 算法以获得某种预期结果为目标，使用适当初始数据时，最终确实能够得到该结果——算法的得出结果性。
